verdict.rationale: Outlook documents Inbox rules that handle incoming messages and can forward specific mail, which covers the rule-based routing half of the story. Nothing in the evidence shows assigning a conversation to a teammate with explicit ownership. Categories, follow-up flags and send-on-behalf delegation are related features, not assignment. Missing for 10: conversation assignment to teammates, explicit ownership tracking, team-level (shared) routing evidence, independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As a team-lead, I can assign conversations to teammates and route incoming mail with rules so ownership is explicit

citations.quote: Apps can set up [Inbox rules](/en-us/graph/api/resources/messagerule) to promptly handle incoming messages and reduce email clutter.
Use Inbox rules to automate actions such as forwarding specific incoming messages
